Animations now switch automatically based on the foreground app.
In this mode, swiping presets will not change the running animation. Assign apps to presets in settings to control what plays automatically.
Allows the app to send LED animations and presets to Bifrost.
Bifrost uses Accessibility screenshot capture to sample your screen continuously without repeating capture prompts.
Allows Bifrost to capture display frames for LED ambient effects.
Needed for App Profile mode so Bifrost can detect foreground apps and auto-switch presets.
You can now start Bifrost and keep it running in background until you press Stop or Kill.
A crash report was saved on this device
Sending it helps fix the problem. Nothing is sent automatically, and the report contains only the error, your Android version and your device model.
One small network request at launch
Bifrost can check the plugin store for updates each time it starts.\n\nThis is off by default. You can change it anytime in the Plugin Store.
Ambient and AmbiAurora will look less fluid

Accessibility capture never asks for permission again, but it samples the screen more slowly, so Ambient and AmbiAurora animations lose smoothness.\n\nScreen capture stays fluid and is the default. It asks for permission once per launch.
Allows Bifrost to capture display frames for LED effects.
Set up a Switch profile? Bifrost will add a \"%1$s\" preset (left stick neon blue, right stick neon red, like the original Joy-Con) and play it automatically while these emulators are open.
Set up a Switch profile? Bifrost will use your existing \"%1$s\" preset (unchanged) for these emulators while they are open.

Deletes the \"%1$s\" preset and the app assignments that use it. Your other presets and assignments stay.

Cocoon doesn\'t share its theme with other apps, so Bifrost can match the system colour palette Android derives from your wallpaper instead.\n\nBifrost will add a \"Cocoon Match\" preset in your accent colour (used when no app profile matches, unless you already chose a fallback) and switch its own look to the System palette theme. Both follow your theme when it changes. Turn it off anytime in Settings.
Neutral preset and app colours follow the system palette
Couldn\'t read a theme palette; nothing was changed
Adds a \"Thor Purple\" preset and switches Bifrost to the OLED Purple look. Bifrost can\'t tell your Thor\'s shell colour from the hardware, so this is a manual choice.
